evidence.curator_note: Eq 8.1, top pathway: the pent-2-ene molecular ion (top structure, dHf/IE 8.7(9.0)) fragments by the arrow labeled 'alpha' (rate 1.0) to give the neutral methyl radical H3C. (dHf 1.5) plus the C4H7+ cation drawn as CH2=CH-CH(+)-CH3 (the 1-methylallyl / but-3-en-2-yl cation, (60%), dHf/IE 8.8(7.5)). This is allylic (alpha) cleavage: the C-C bond one removed from the ring double bond breaks, ejecting the ethyl-end methyl and leaving a resonance-stabilized allyl cation. Book draws 0 curved arcs on this page (energetics scheme). All 3 fishhooks are reconstructed for balance: (1) the odd electron on C3 forms the new C2=C3 pi bond, (2) one electron of the breaking C1-C2 sigma bond also forms that pi bond, (3) the other electron of C1-C2 departs with C1 as the methyl radical. LOCALIZATION (convention C): the page draws pent-2-ene as an intact alkene with a delocalized (+.); encoded as the opened distonic form (odd electron on C3, charge on C4) so the arrows have a real origin. The product 1-methylallyl cation is drawn by McLafferty exactly in this Kekule form (CH2=CH-CH(+)-CH3), one of its two resonance structures (partner +CH2-CH=CH-CH3).

Cross-linked MOD rule IMS_8_1_var1_step2 ('monomolecular ion-cleavage 8.1 alpha 1.0'). Its DFS cleaves the terminal C-C bond of the ethyl end (their C2-C5) to emit [C.]2 = .CH3 and a C4H7+ cation, i.e. the SAME net alpha-cleavage encoded here (loss of CH3. from pent-2-ene giving C4H7+), and the cleaved bond IS incident to a pi-forming carbon (their C5, which enters the new C5=C8 double bond) -- geometry consistent, no incidence mismatch. PARTIAL MISMATCH in the product representation: the MOD rule bundles an extra H-migration (H7 from C5 to C10) into the cleavage and writes the resulting cation over-valently, so its C4H7+ is an ambiguous/over-valent structure rather than the clean 1-methylallyl cation drawn in the book and encoded here.

Book prints '(60%)' relative abundance next to the C4H7+ cation. observed_mz 55.0542 is the curator-computed electron-mass-corrected monoisotopic m/z of C4H7+ (m/z 55); the page prints only the % abundance and dHf/IE (8.8(7.5) eV), no m/z.
